captions.threads:
Success tastes like poison when it's built on someone else's blueprint.

1/4 You climb the ladder they handed you. You nail every rung. Then one day you realize you're scaling the wrong building entirely. The costume fit perfectly at first, that identity they all agreed you should wear. But skin grows. Consciousness expands. What fit at level three suffocates you at level seven.

2/4 The brutal part nobody tells you: outgrowing doesn't feel like victory. It feels like betrayal. You're suddenly allergic to the very thing that made you credible, that gave you belonging. Your audience expects one version. Your soul is screaming for another. That gap is real and it hurts.

3/4 I've watched creators abort entire audiences because staying in character meant slow death.
